proposals.title: Policy-divergence-gated daily trend (PIT vintage semantics)
proposals.conditioning_series: BIS WS_CBPOL policy rates (US/EA/GB/JP/CH/CA/AU/NZ), availability-gated as-of reads; ECB SDMX EXR deliberately unused (EXR is not a policy-rate series)
proposals.mechanism_one_line: Daily 21-bar momentum book on the 7-pair universe whose entries require the 63-day PIT policy-differential drift to agree in sign with the trend; carries the frozen financing formula (carry-adjacent, dual book).
proposals.incremental_benchmark: unconditional 21-bar momentum book, identical clock/fills/universe/warmup/costs; overall incremental alpha = per-pair-day after-cost financing-adjusted PnL, anchor minus benchmark > 0
proposals.control_non_reproduction_rule: control (macro-direction-only, sign(g)) fails the family if its full-sample after-cost financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.10 (inherited control_reject_pf)
proposals.data_dependency: live BIS WS_CBPOL warmup coverage is NOT_PROVEN_ON_LIVE_FETCH per data_authority_v3.json; proposal is BLOCKED_DATA if the P3 freeze / Q data-hash gate fails coverage for all eight rate areas — no silent price-only fallback

proposals.title: Daily panel-outlier reversal in a high-dispersion state
proposals.conditioning_series: none (signal uses only the authorized H1 snapshot daily 16:00-NY flat-bar closes; financing book per frozen formula applies to all arms as a book attribute)
proposals.mechanism_one_line: Fade 5-day panel-relative outlier pairs (|z|>1 vs the 7-pair cross-section) only in a high-cross-sectional-dispersion state; exit on z zero-crossing or 10-bar time stop.
proposals.incremental_benchmark: ungated panel-outlier reversal (dispersion-state gate removed), identical clock/fills/universe/warmup/costs; overall incremental alpha = per-pair-day after-cost financing-adjusted PnL, anchor minus benchmark > 0
proposals.control_non_reproduction_rule: control (time-series-z reversal, no panel centering, same state gate) fails the family if its full-sample after-cost financing-adjusted expectancy > 0 AND PF >= 1.10 (inherited control_reject_pf)
proposals.data_dependency: price snapshot only; 156/156 digest replay already PASS in data_authority_v3.json
